messages:
Jon: Heads-up — NorthBank is asking for SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, 7-year audit log retention, and KMS/HSM evidence. Sales asked: can we commit within 6w?
Maria: Adding the intake form + original questionnaire PDF. Upload: https://redwood-share/nbqna.pdf 
ComplianceBot: New questionnaire intake created: ID nq-2026-045 — assignee: none — priority: pending review 
Alex: @Jon can you clarify must-have vs nice-to-have and whether PHI flows are in scope?
Jon: Must-have: SOC2 report access, exportable audit logs, retention >= 6 years. Nice: on-prem/private, HSM. Timeline: they want a commitment in 6w to close deal.
Dina: Do they require KMS audit logs only or full HSM attestations? Also need confirmation of PHI flows and where (ingest vs storage).
Jon: They'll transmit PHI in some pipelines. HIPAA applies. HSM was requested but they're ok with KMS logs + BAA if we can't stand up HSM in timeline.
Prateek: Quick feasibility note — backend-only audit export + long retention is ~2 engineers x 2 sprints if no UI. Adding per-customer UI + lifecycle policies -> add ~2 more sprints. HSM/KMS deep integration is separate infra work.
Alex: Proposed triage split:
  - Scope A (Quick win): curated evidence packet + on-demand CSV audit exports + legal templates for SOC2 artifacts — target ~2w
  - Scope B (Medium): per-customer retention config UI + automated export to customer S3 + retention enforcement — target 6-8w
  - Scope C (Large): Private deployment + KMS/HSM integration + BAA onboarding + dedicated SLA — 3+ months
Maria: Customer explicitly asked for an "evidence packet" they can hand to their auditors. Can we produce a sample format?
Dina: I'll draft a checklist of items we can provide automatically: SOC2 cert, encryption-in-transit docs, KMS audit log snippet, access control matrix, data flow diagrams, and sample logs.
Prateek: Example retention config we could expose to customers:
```
{ "customer_id": "nb-123", "audit_log_retention_days": 2555, "export_destination": "s3://nb-audit-exports" }
```
Alex: Launch criteria for Scope A: evidence packet template + sample audit export proves reproducible + Legal sign-off on BAA language + Support playbook for customer handoff. If we hit Scope A, present to customer in ~2w.
Jon: Customer is fine with staged approach if we commit to Scope A date. They flagged evidence packet as P0.
Alex: Actions:
  - @Dina: produce evidence checklist (due in 3 business days)
  - @Prateek: create backend-export ticket and provide EOD estimate for backend-only approach
  - @Maria: send intake + contract notes to Legal and attach questionnaire PDF
  - @Jon: confirm staged-delivery acceptance with customer and request written ack
Moving this thread to product backlog as "customer-compliance-evidence-intake". Tentative priority: P1 while contract active; re-evaluate if scope increases. :white_check_mark:
